## Summary

Describe the problem and the implemented approach.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests pass
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages are in English and follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] New UI strings exist in pt-BR, English, and Spanish
- [ ] User-visible changes update all required changelogs and documentation
- [ ] New features include a use case and onboarding tour in all three languages
- [ ] No secrets, databases, workspace data, models, or build artifacts are included
- [ ] Visual changes include screenshots or a short recording
